description: Defines the TextFragment class and related iterator for handling text segments, including substring operations, comparisons, and iteration within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: Represents a segment of text with methods for comparison, trimming, and substring extraction.

classes.name: TextSegmentIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing segments of a TextFragment based on delimiters.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between TextFragments or with C-style strings or std::string.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality between TextFragments or with C-style strings or std::string.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the TextFragment is empty.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the text segment.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the start of the text data.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Returns the text segment as a std::string.

methods.name: EqualText
methods.description: Compares TextFragments with optional case sensitivity.

methods.name: ForwardFind
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a character or set of characters.

methods.name: ReverseFind
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a set of characters.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances iterator to the next segment.
